style: senior-friendly soft fruit memory game effects: warm, rounded, moderate volume, no harsh buzzer tones
designNotes: Moderate volume to reduce startle response.
Mostly 250-800Hz fundamentals with only light harmonics for clarity.
Rounded attacks and short tails so sounds feel gentle and do not clutter the game.
Incorrect-answer cue is supportive rather than punitive.

files.usage: General button press
files.description: Gentle wooden pop: cute, short, low-stress, without sharp high frequencies.

files.usage: Sound on/off toggles
files.description: Soft two-step toggle cue with a rounded switch feeling.

files.usage: Countdown pulse
files.description: Clear but gentle countdown tick, easy to notice without startling.

files.usage: Game start
files.description: Warm three-note start cue that feels inviting and unhurried.

files.usage: Correct answer
files.description: Positive soft chime, encouraging without being loud or piercing.

files.usage: Retry hint after wrong answer
files.description: Kind prompt sound that suggests another try, not failure.

files.usage: Final incorrect answer
files.description: Low supportive cue with no buzzer quality, designed to avoid discouragement.

files.usage: Result screen / game complete
files.description: Gentle completion flourish with a warm, celebratory but calm finish.
